usageNotes: Use this to verify a PDM node's current UTC time, local time, and configured timezone — useful for confirming NTP sync or diagnosing timestamp drift before correlating logs across nodes. No query parameters are required; the node must be reachable. Available to all authenticated users (no admin privilege needed).

examples.summary: Read time settings from a PDM node

tips: The 'time' field is UTC epoch seconds; 'localtime' is the same instant expressed in the node's configured timezone offset — subtract the two to derive the UTC offset in seconds.
Use 'localhost' as the node name when calling from the node itself or when only one node is present.
If 'time' and 'localtime' differ unexpectedly, check the timezone setting against /usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab on the node.
